The Founder

Fortis is built on hands-on experience, not a business plan written in a vacuum.

1+ yrs experience $5,500+ freelance earned
From the founder

Mukhdum Arman

Founder, Fortis Agency — Creative Director, Graphic Designer & Video Editor

FORTIS began with a simple belief: ambitious businesses need more than isolated services — they need strategy, creative thinking, technology and execution working together. That belief comes from experience, not theory. Mukhdum built his career hands-on, across creative direction, design, video and web work — including Bangladesh government digital projects like BMET and the e-Passport website, plus collaborations with Digital Dropouts, Code2Product and CodeMaster.io. FORTIS is the next stage of that work: one agency built to take a business from idea to execution, from execution to growth, and from manual operations to intelligent systems.
